title: Step 1: Add Friend System (send/accept/decline requests, friends list)

requirements.summary: Add React Query hooks for all friend system backend functions
acceptanceCriteria: Each mutation hook calls its corresponding backend method via useActor
Query hooks use appropriate staleTime and invalidate related queries on mutation success

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks for friend system: useSendFriendRequest (mutation), useRespondToFriendRequest (mutation with sender and accept parameters), useCancelFriendRequest (mutation), useUnfriend (mutation), useGetIncomingFriendRequests (query with staleTime 30s), useGetOutgoingFriendRequests (query with staleTime 30s), useGetFriendsList (query with staleTime 60s), and useGetFriendshipStatus (query with otherPrincipal parameter). All mutations should invalidate friend-related queries on success.

requirements.summary: Update UserProfilePage to show dynamic friend request button based on friendship status
acceptanceCriteria: Friend button states correctly reflect getFriendshipStatus result
Actions trigger the corresponding mutation hooks
UI updates optimistically or refetches after each action

file_operations.description: Add friend action button component that uses useGetFriendshipStatus to determine current state. Display 'Add Friend' button when status is 'notConnected'. Display 'Request Sent' with cancel option when status is 'pendingOutgoing'. Display 'Accept' and 'Decline' buttons when status is 'pendingIncoming'. Display 'Friends' with dropdown containing 'Unfriend' option when status is 'friends'. Wire each action to the appropriate mutation hook (useSendFriendRequest, useCancelFriendRequest, useRespondToFriendRequest, useUnfriend). Position the button near the existing follow/message actions in the profile header.
